steps.name: Plan check 4 (CORE): custom title preserved on edit with default settings
steps.action: Capture 'Alpha original content'; set description CUSTOM-TITLE-XYZ via Copy Properties; edit content to 'Beta edited content' in Ditto Editor; save; re-verify
steps.context: (a) UpdateDescWhenSaving registry value confirmed absent before the check. (b) 'Alpha original content' captured as top entry. (c) Description set to CUSTOM-TITLE-XYZ via Copy Properties dialog (Alt+Enter on selected clip; Item Title field), verified in list as '|CUSTOM-TITLE-XYZ'. (d) Ditto Editor opened via context menu Edit Clip; 'Update clip description on save?' checkbox read as Off (new default - the change under test); content replaced with 'Beta edited content'; saved via Save command (ID_BUTTON_SAVE 32862 -> CEditWnd::OnSave -> SaveToDB with modify flag forced since validator set text via WM_SETTEXT). (e) Editor reopened: content persisted as 'Beta edited content' (proves save reached DB); Quick Paste list still shows description 'CUSTOM-TITLE-XYZ' - NOT overwritten with the start of 'Beta edited content'. Byte-identical custom title preserved. Note: two validator tooling artifacts occurred and were corrected during this check (WM_SETTEXT does not set the RichEdit modify flag so EM_SETMODIFY was forced; first save attempt targeted the frame window whose ID_BUTTON_SAVE handler is OnDummy, corrected to the CEditWnd child pane). Neither is an app defect; final save was verified by DB persistence and clean close without save prompt.

summary: All 12 protocol/plan steps passed. Build contains the change (Options.cpp default GetUpdateDescWhenSavingClip FALSE). On a fresh-install state (UpdateDescWhenSaving absent), editing a clip's content with the 'Update clip description on save?' checkbox at its new Off default preserves a manually set custom description byte-identically (core regression check for sabrogden/Ditto#1167). Opt-in regeneration (checkbox On) still overwrites the description, and the checkbox choice persists across edits and app restarts of the setting (registry round-trip verified both ways). Evidence: 15 screenshots in validation/shots plus programmatic UIA/ListView/registry verification. Caveats: tray icon could not be conclusively confirmed via Win11 flyout UIA enumeration (Quick Paste window used as launch evidence instead, per plan); machine's configured hotkey Ctrl+Shift+V used instead of Ctrl+` default.
